title: Vendor Token Broker registry
description: Shape of the broker registry (REGISTRY_PATH) per docs/design.md §4.5 and docs/operations.md. A map of vendor_id to vendor record. Client credentials never appear here — they live in the custody backend's vendor-clients mount.

oneOf.description: Vendor publishes RFC 8414 metadata — hardcoding endpoints is forbidden.
No metadata published — explicit endpoints allowed.

token_endpoint_auth_method.description: private_key_jwt preferred where the vendor supports it (design §3).

scope_ceiling.description: Hard cap on requestable scopes (design §4.2). Empty means scopes are governed vendor-side (e.g. GitHub App permissions): the broker then neither requests nor enforces required_scopes. Changing this requires token-contract-level sign-off.

refresh_rotation.description: True when the vendor rotates refresh tokens on use. Informational: single-flight refresh (design §8) applies to every vendor regardless.

enabled_env.description: Environment variable gating this vendor's activation (lab convention).

revocation.description: Revocation strategy: RFC 7009 endpoint or a documented vendor-specific deviation (e.g. GitHub grant deletion). An rfc7009 vendor whose metadata has no revocation_endpoint is deleted locally only (audited outcome: unsupported).
